reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact 65x67 source PNG, complete unchanged 2048x2048 raw RGBA, full white/cyan/alpha review sheet and unchanged naiwa.png mascot reference; checked cap, covered hair, brows, short upper-lip moustache versus chin/jaw hair, one mouth, eyewear, uniform, pose, crop, lighting, collar, complete card/note/backplate and visible transparency.

entries.positive_observation: The dark navy peaked cap with gold wreath-like front insignia and narrow gold visor ornament, covered hair and dark eyebrows remain. The prominent short dark moustache stays limited to the upper lip and has not expanded into a beard; the chin and jaw are smooth, with one stern closed mouth and no spectacles. The near-frontal head and shoulders, direct gaze, chest-up crop and warm frontal light with cap-brim shadow are retained. One dark navy uniform, white pointed shirt collar, one dark tie and one gold-toned shoulder board at viewer left remain. The collar fits a short broad neck directly beneath the rounded chin, without a long yellow column, pinching, clipping or cream bib. The complete tilted dark frame, opaque muted gray-olive photographic backplate, overlapping warm-cream note with faint upper marks and mostly blank lower paper, and small dark right-edge tab remain. Actual full white/cyan inspection shows a genuine transparent exterior without visible interior holes, lost backing or a working-matte ring.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept native RGBA extrema 0..254 following actual white/cyan/alpha viewing rather than numeric screening alone; no source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: Exact cap badge, visor ornament and shoulder embroidery cannot be read precisely at 65x67; only visible metallic colors, shapes and placement were compared without inventing detailed emblems. Note marks remain indistinct visual groups, not readable text.
